The '''Great Gran Run''' was a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]] that ran from [[Kinyen/Legends|Kinyen]] at the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]] out to [[Cerea/Legends|Cerea]], where it terminated.

During the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Destrier/Legends|Destrier]]'' and the [[77th Air Wing]] fought in various engagements against [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]], [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|Separatist holdouts]] along the Great Gran Run.
